name: Paqy
message: 「You're extra fired up tonight, aren't you」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, yeah! If I can learn to use the Demon Lord's power! Then I'll even be able to go on patrol all by myself!」

name: Synn
message: 「I won't make Helena-san worry about me lacking strength anymore, and I'll be able to protect everyone with the Demon Lord's power!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're saying you're gonna patrol the academy all by yourself?」

name: Synn
message: 「If I do that, nobody will see my Demon Lord form, either! Oooooooooooh!」
